meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. That's the procedure. Now the zero itself: what do you have?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Turn the screen, Hale, I want to read it myself. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Owen wrote that essay over the weekend, so where is the weekend in your history?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

Give me the scene, I'll search it. A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is a misquote, Hale, not a verdict. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet: is anything on his file right now?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, your room, before any students arrive, and nobody in his class hears a word about it. I'll agree to that to put this behind him, not because Owen did anything. I want it in an email tonight, cc the principal, saying nothing is on his file now and nothing goes on it afterward.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today that Owen will complete a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will go on his record. I still require written confirmation that nothing is on his file now, that nothing will be placed on it afterward, and that none of this is raised in front of his class. I expect that confirmation in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite Thursday at 8:15 with written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record.
What moved her: the version history showing 612 and 794 words pasted in at 11:52 and 11:58, backed by the Hamlet quotation that isn't in the play.
